title: Tunisian White Chicken and Sauerkraut Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and healthy stir fry made with juicy chicken, sauerkraut, and spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion and chili peppers to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut to the skillet and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Serve the chicken and sauerkraut mixture hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
